Fasudil Hydrochloride (rINNM) AT-877; Fasudil, Chlorhydrate de; Fasudili Hydrochloridum; HA- 1077; Hidrocloruro de fasudil. Hexahydro-1-(5-isoquinolylsulfo- nyl)-1H-1,4-diazepine hydrochloride. Фазудила Гидрохлорид C14H17N3O2S,HCl = 327.8. CAS — 103745-39-7 (fasudil); 105628-07-7 (fasudil hy- drochloride). ATC — C04AX32. ATC Vet — QC04AX32. (fasudil) Profile Fasudil is a selective inhibitor of Rho-kinase, a protein kinase involved in contraction of vascular smooth muscle. Fasudil is used as the hydrochloride for its vasodilating properties in the management of cerebrovascular disorders including vasospasm after surgery for subarachnoid haemorrhage. It is under investi- gation for the treatment of angina pectoris, acute cerebral throm- bosis, and pulmonary hypertension. ◊ References. 1. Shibuya M, et al.
